clue.text: Made to appear naff when using it?

definitions.text: Made to appear naff when using it?

parts.words: Made to appear naff when using it?
parts.note: on an old phone keypad the letters of 'made' and 'naff' sit on the same keys, 6-2-3-3, so a phone guessing the word you mean can turn one into the other

explanation.walkthrough: Old phones had three or four letters on each number key, and software guessed the word from the key presses. 'Made' and 'naff' (British slang for tacky) use the same four keys, so one could come out as the other.
explanation.definitionFit: Phone software that guesses whole words from keypad presses is exactly what can swap one word for another sharing its keys.

clue.text: Southern guy I meant to say curbing Northern spirit

indicators.note: to curb is to hold in, so these letters enclose the next piece

parts.note: a guy is a chap, a man
PS, the postscript, is where a letter writer adds what they meant to say

explanation.surface: A man from the south, correcting himself, restrains a drinker from the north.
explanation.walkthrough: 'curbing' puts N inside CHAPPS after CHAP's H.
explanation.definitionFit: Schnapps is a strong distilled drink, a kind of spirit.

clue.text: Eat noisily for a laugh

indicators.note: something done noisily is heard, so the word is taken as it sounds when spoken

parts.note: to ingest food is to eat it

explanation.surface: Someone chomps their food loudly just to get a laugh.
explanation.definitionFit: Doing something in jest means doing it as a joke, for a laugh.

clue.text: Route for jog modern women lay out?

indicators.note: out means put out of order, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A path for runners laid out by today's women.
explanation.walkthrough: 'out' rearranges the letters of MODERN WOMEN LAY. The definition turns on jogging the memory, not jogging along a road.
explanation.definitionFit: A trip along this lane is the idiom for recalling the past, the path a jogged memory takes.

clue.text: Means of getting through to me in clerical work

indicators.note: to work something is to knead or shape it, so these letters are reshaped

explanation.surface: Someone describes how a message reaches them in the office.
explanation.walkthrough: 'work' rearranges the fourteen letters of TO ME IN CLERICAL.
explanation.definitionFit: Messages sent by computer are a way of contacting, or getting through to, someone.

clue.text: Groom up-and-coming youngsters bottling new cure

indicators.note: to bottle is to hold inside, so these letters enclose the next piece
in a down clue, coming up means the word is read from bottom to top, backwards

parts.note: pups are young animals, youngsters

indicators.note: new means remade, so these letters are rearranged

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: Promising young people are kept in a fresh remedy to tidy them.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Groom' looks like a noun for a bridegroom or stable hand, but it is a verb: to make smart. 'up-and-coming' reads the young dogs upwards in this down clue, and 'bottling' holds the reshuffled cure.
explanation.definitionFit: To groom yourself is to smarten up, to make yourself neat.

clue.text: Statesman who's through firing and hiring?

indicators.note: the answer runs through the words that follow, spread across them

explanation.surface: A politician who is finished with sacking and recruiting staff.
explanation.walkthrough: The answer runs across firinG AND HIring.
explanation.definitionFit: Mahatma Gandhi led India's independence movement, a statesman of world rank.

clue.text: Chicks located under throne by deserving writer

indicators.note: in a down clue, a piece under another comes after it

parts.note: throne is slang for a lavatory, as is john
chicks is slang for girls, gals
deserving means worthy

explanation.surface: Baby birds found beneath a royal seat beside a worthy author.
explanation.walkthrough: 'throne' and 'john' are both slang for a lavatory. JOHN GALSWORTHY wrote The Forsyte Saga.
explanation.definitionFit: John Galsworthy was an English novelist and playwright, a Nobel prize winning writer.

clue.text: King with French horn twirling left abandoned returning music genre

indicators.note: twirling turns the word round, so it is read backwards

parts.note: cor is the French word for horn
K is the chess abbreviation for king

indicators.note: returning means going back, so these letters are read backwards

parts.note: lorn means forsaken, abandoned

explanation.surface: A monarch spins a brass instrument, and a jilted lover comes back to a style of music.
explanation.walkthrough: 'twirling' turns COR into ROC; 'returning' turns L + LORN into NROLL.
explanation.definitionFit: This is the style of popular music Elvis, the King, made famous in the 1950s.

clue.text: I used to think soldiers in a group fail to get on

indicators.note: failing to get something leaves it missing, so these letters are removed

parts.note: a platoon is a group of soldiers
taken as written

explanation.surface: A soldier recalls that his unit could not get along.
explanation.walkthrough: 'I used to think' is the ancient philosopher speaking for himself.
explanation.definitionFit: Plato was a Greek philosopher, a thinker of the distant past, so he could say this of himself.

clue.text: Crap time had here

parts.note: crap is coarse slang for dung
an eon is a long stretch of time

explanation.surface: Someone moans that they had a rotten time in this place.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue defines: a prison cell is where a prisoner has a crap time.
explanation.definitionFit: An underground prison cell is a place where anyone held has a miserable time.

clue.text: Keeping up with the fellow-compiling Joneses?

definitions.text: Keeping up with the fellow-compiling Joneses?

parts.words: Keeping up with the fellow-compiling Joneses?
parts.note: keeping up with the Joneses is matching your neighbours; here the neighbours are other setters, and keeping abreast of them means being well informed

explanation.walkthrough: The phrase means well informed, and puns on putting clues in, as compilers do.
explanation.definitionFit: Being well informed, up to date with what is going on, is what this hyphenated phrase means.

clue.text: Heady protuberance turns up in scan

indicators.note: in means placed inside the next piece

parts.note: a CAT scan is a kind of body scan

indicators.note: turns means flips round, so this word is read backwards

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A bulge on the head shows up on a medical image.
explanation.walkthrough: A CAT scan is a medical X-ray image of the body in slices. 'Heady' is a joke: the protuberance is literally of the head, not intoxicating.
explanation.definitionFit: Caput is the anatomical term for the head or a head-like knob on an organ.

clue.text: Brand, say, written on outside of can for goods exchange

parts.note: a brand is a mark

indicators.note: written round the outside, so these letters enclose the next piece

parts.note: say means for example, EG
a can is a tin

explanation.surface: A label printed on a tin for trading.
explanation.walkthrough: 'say' is the usual crossword signal for 'for example', and 'written on outside of' wraps those two letters round the can.
explanation.definitionFit: Buying and selling goods is trade, the commercial activity of a market.

clue.text: See 4
See 8
Board of control met unit planners to thrash it out

indicators.note: thrashing out is working over until settled, so these letters are reworked

explanation.surface: Planners from one unit gathered to settle a dispute.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to thrash it out' rearranges MET UNIT PLANNERS.
explanation.definitionFit: A dashboard holding dials and switches is a board from which a machine is controlled.

clue.text: Assignation of new entitlement from the polls?

definitions.text: Assignation of new entitlement from the polls?

parts.words: Assignation of new entitlement from the polls?
parts.note: giving someone a new title or name, with a hint that an election names its winner again

explanation.walkthrough: 'Assignation' here means assigning, not a lovers' meeting, and 'entitlement' is being given a title.
explanation.definitionFit: Giving something a new title is the act of calling it by a fresh name.

clue.text: Insult divers find acceptable to the French sub

indicators.note: to accept something is to take it in, so these letters enclose the next piece
divers is an old word for various, so these letters are put in varied order

parts.note: taken as written
au is French for to the

explanation.surface: Divers find an insult unacceptable in a French submarine.
explanation.walkthrough: 'divers' looks like people swimming underwater, fitting a submarine, but it is the old adjective meaning various, the shuffle signal. 'find acceptable' then takes in the French for 'to the'.
explanation.definitionFit: The Nautilus is Captain Nemo's submarine in Jules Verne's novel, and the name of the first nuclear sub.

clue.text: The odd coin pocketed by sorceress in retiring spell

indicators.note: pocketed means held inside, so this piece goes inside the other
retiring means drawing back, so these letters are read backwards

parts.note: Circe is the sorceress of the Odyssey
a cent is a coin

explanation.surface: A coin is swallowed while a witch casts a spell backwards.
explanation.walkthrough: Circe is the enchantress of Homer's Odyssey who turned men into pigs. 'in retiring spell' turns her name back to front, and 'pocketed by' places the coin inside.
explanation.definitionFit: An odd person, someone peculiar, is called this as a noun.

clue.text: Managed Big Apple clubs with promotion for opening

indicators.note: promotion moves something up, here to the front of the down answer

parts.note: managed means ran, as in ran a business
the Big Apple is New York, NY
C is the card abbreviation for clubs

explanation.surface: Someone ran New York's nightspots and got a step up.
explanation.walkthrough: 'with promotion' moves C from the end to the top.
explanation.definitionFit: A cranny is a small gap or chink, an opening.

clue.text: Wife's ceaseless bellyache

indicators.note: without a cease, its end, so the last letter is removed

parts.note: to bellyache is to complain, to squawk

explanation.surface: A wife complains endlessly.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is an old, now offensive word for a Native American wife.
explanation.definitionFit: This dated, offensive term meant a Native American woman or wife.

clue.text: Make light of second designate pinching right

indicators.note: pinching means squeezing in, so these letters hold the next piece

parts.note: designate, as in bride-to-be, means to be

explanation.surface: Someone dismisses a second appointee who stole.
explanation.walkthrough: 'pinching' puts R inside TOBE. 'to-be' means designate, as in bride-to-be.
explanation.definitionFit: To strobe is to flash a light on and off rapidly.

clue.text: Paradoxical problem Martin has? Restraint

indicators.note: paradoxical means going against what you expect, so these letters are read backwards
the words have the answer within them

explanation.surface: Martin is stuck with a paradox, and the outcome is a restriction.
explanation.walkthrough: The answer is hidden backwards in probLEM MARTin.
explanation.definitionFit: A trammel is a hindrance, something that restrains free movement.

clue.text: See 1
In saying it accompanies more water, MP putting on other hat

indicators.note: the letters M and P swap roles here, as M takes P's place

parts.note: Perrier is a brand of mineral water

explanation.surface: A politician changes hats and drinks water.
explanation.walkthrough: The saying is 'the more the merrier'. In 'MP putting on other hat', P changes to M.
explanation.definitionFit: In the proverb 'the more the merrier', this word comes after 'more'.

clue.text: See 5
Ten to zero, counting backwards? It's elementary

parts.note: X is the Roman numeral for ten

indicators.note: counting backwards means reading the word in reverse

parts.note: zero means none

explanation.surface: A countdown from ten to zero.
explanation.walkthrough: 'counting backwards' turns NONE into ENON.
explanation.definitionFit: Xenon is a chemical element, a noble gas.

clue.text: Supply RNA to supplement form of bluish cleaner

indicators.note: a form of something is it in another shape, so these letters are rearranged

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: Genetic material is added to something blue to make a cleaner.
explanation.walkthrough: 'form of' rearranges RNA with BLUISH.
explanation.definitionFit: A small brush for scrubbing fingernails is a cleaner for the hands.
